ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms session cases, protected routes and the revoked-session flag are declared; it does not probe a live session.
offer: Probe session invalidation and protected-route behavior, not merely successful login. A revoked or expired session must lose access even when its cookie still exists.

minimal.reason: List the session cases probed, such as expiry and logout. Testing only login misses invalidation, so name each case.

mid.reason: List the protected routes the cases hit. Unlisted routes may be public by accident, so name them.

maximal.reason: Set accepting a revoked session to false. A revoked or expired session must lose access even if its cookie exists, so enforce invalidation.
